name: Digital.gov Site Scanner
description: Assess compliance with the 21st Century Integrated Digital Experience Act (IDEA).
project_description:
The 21st Century IDEA Site Scanner is a tool designed to help agencies ensure their websites comply with the 21st Century IDEA Act guidelines and other federal regulations. This module provides a detailed status overview of various compliance checks directly within the Drupal administrative interface.

 Key Features: 
 
 Website Checker: Performs automated checks for IPv6 compliance, Digital Analytics Program integration, U.S. Web Design Standards (USWDS) implementation, and more. 
 Actionable Insights: Each compliance check returns detailed insights, making it easier for you to identify and rectify compliance gaps. 
 
 Benefits: 
 
 Ensure Compliance: Stay compliant with federal regulations by regularly checking the compliance status of your website. 
 Save Time: Quickly identify issues without the need for external scanning tools or services. 
 
 Getting Started: 
 Install the Idealyzer module from the Drupal admin panel and navigate to /admin/reports/gov-status to view your site’s compliance status. For detailed documentation on how to configure and use this module, refer to the included help files.

 For more information on site scanning and compliance with the IDEA Act, visit Digital.gov .
